answer: Every identity you clone is a new bill, not a new asset: registration costs a bond, each epoch costs a review, and a failed audit slashes the bond. Rewards vest against future work, so month one's payout arrives around month three if the account is still alive. A zephyr of fresh aliases looks impressive on a dashboard and costs real money to keep breathing, since each one is an echo of the same worker with its own bill. The relic of a big registered count means nothing once the audits land. Cheaper to do the work, which is presumably the point.
